thread:
Iris: Morning team, Iris here (cloud infra, day 2). Quick map request: who do I ping for Dedicated GPU access, routing policy edits (latency vs cost), and alert threshold changes? Trying not to spam the wrong channels.

ops-bot: Welcome Iris! Starter checklist: https://wiki.redwood.com/onboarding/week1. For handoffs see the handbook owners page.

Tomas: Short version: eng-platform owns routing policy config; eng-runtime owns model-variant fallbacks. eng-access/infra (Nadia) handles Dedicated GPU invites & quotas.

Iris: If I need a quick quota bump for a staging spike, fastest path?

Nadia: Open an infra-requests ticket with pool name + expected qps, then DM me the ticket link for fast-track. Normal turnaround 24-48h, we can do temporary bursts if urgent.

Iris: Who gets paged for runtime latency spikes?

Tomas: Page eng-runtime oncall first. If infra nodes or networking are implicated, eng-sre gets paged as well. For customer-impacting outages page product-oncall per the playbook. Link: https://playbooks.redwood.com/runtime-p99

Iris: Alert threshold edits  reviewer etiquette?

Nadia: Minor tweaks = PR to infra-alerts and add @eng-sre + @eng-runtime as reviewers with a short rationale. Major changes = schedule a 15-min sync with SRE first.

Iris: Perfect, thanks all. I'll file the GPU request and tag Nadia.

Nadia: Welcome aboard 44b - ping me if you want a fast approve.
